jobWork.title: Job work
jobWork.subtitle: Goods sent out on challan, not invoice · return deadlines tracked
jobWork.customerTitle: Customer material in is not built yet
jobWork.customerBody: Receiving a customer's own material for job work is not part of this phase. It is listed as an open question for the owner.
jobWork.emptyTitle: No goods sent for job work yet
jobWork.emptyBody: Use New job-work challan to send inputs, capital goods or mould parts to a job worker. The stock stays ours at the job worker's place.

banner.overdue: {{no}} is {{n}} days past its return date.
banner.body: {{qty}} of {{goods}} still at {{who}}. Inputs not returned within the limit are treated as supplied and GST becomes payable.

limits.title: Return limits
limits.note: From Settings (jobwork.return_years), confirmed by the CA. A challan not back by its limit opens a Bug fixer item for the CA.

itc.title: ITC-04 · {{period}}
itc.counts: {{sent}} challans sent · {{back}} with goods back · {{workers}} job workers

new_.title: New job-work challan
new_.hint: The goods leave on a delivery challan (goods not sold) from the sending branch's challan series. They stay in our stock at the job worker's place until they come back.
new_.fill: Choose the job worker and the place, and add at least one item with a quantity above zero.
new_.processHelp: What the job worker will do, e.g. machining or plating.

back.title: Goods back on {{no}}
back.hint: Enter only the lines that came back. Each line can never settle more than is still with the job worker; the server refuses it.
back.fill: Enter a quantity above zero on at least one line.
back.inputHelp: Needed when the finished item differs from what was sent.
